issue.title: Vue inline rendering broken in 6.4-beta

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
Running `npx sb@next repro` generates a storybook where the button stories don't render properly on the Docs tab, which is causing the new e2e docs test to fail.

However:
- [x] The button borders render correctly
- [x] Vue stories in the monorepo render correctly

Therefore it appears that inline rendering is at least **partially** working, FWIW.

=> So perhaps it is a bug with Args in `@storybook/vue`?

Possibly related to this? https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/16154

body:
As I said in #16243, there is no re-render of `DocsContainer` when we change an option from the toolbar and we can deal with it, but its `Canvas` are not re-rendered too.
You can't apply globals or parameters anymore in docs view mode.

So the reason for this issue is hinted at in the discussion in #16243.

In the new store, when you render a **story** it sets up handlers to re-render on various events: https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/28a1d9678e75116953ee6c73c629e978277f37e8/lib/preview-web/src/PreviewWeb.tsx#L531-L539

When you render docs in the v7 inline mode (not quite ready), it will call `renderStoryToElement` and setup the same handlers.

When you render docs in v6 inline mode it does not. So we should probably make docs do what it used to do and re-render whenever the globals change and the args change for **any** story. WDYT @shilman?
